real: BREM-1 / M88A2-class armoured recovery and engineer vehicle on a tank chassis (unit_sheet: M2 Browning 12.7 mm)
shape: unit_sheet.json Phương tiện: a tank chassis without a turret, a folding crane on the roof, a dozer blade in front; from above the crane lies diagonally along the hull, the blade wider than the hull; about 6.9 x 3.0 x 2.6 m (0.8 x M88A2 / BREM-1); the def's modelSize 6.45 x 3.02 x 2.02 m wins; team stripes; no insignia.
confidence: xấp xỉ (BREM-1 layout: slewing crane at the front left, casemate, dozer blade; scaled to modelSize)

features.feature: the low hull (Team) with the V splash board, the crew casemate at the front right with hatch and periscopes
the slewing crane on its ring at the front left, the jib folded back diagonally to its rest, luffing ram, sheave, hook block and cable, hazard stripes
the dozer blade on push arms (`Blade` pivot: the runtime rams it): curved mould board, cutting edge, hydraulic rams, hazard stripes
six road wheels, rear sprocket, front idler on its arm, a linked track under rubber side skirts
the cupola with the M2 on its raised ring with cradle and shield (the self-defence gun), spare 12.7 mm cans
the winch fairlead in the nose, tow hooks, tow bars and a tow cable on the sides, spare track links, crates and jerrycans, smoke launchers on the casemate, grilles and the exhaust
